selection: For each diag_1 in [250.02,428,493], take first 20 rows sorted by numeric encounter_id; concatenate in that order. Preserve selected source values as strings.
source_coding: ICD-9-CM as reported in source; category precision varies. Do not reinterpret as ICD-10-CM.
license_resolution: Preserve original UCI attribution and CC BY 4.0 obligations despite the mirror label.
bias: Purposive equal-stratum teaching subset, not a prevalence sample. Source cohort already selects encounters involving diabetes.
transformation: Selected rows and columns only; semantic derived fields live in separate graphs.
